title.en: A Night Walk at Chengtian Temple

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (from the Dongpo zhilin), including the signature line that the Wikisource editors supply from the Yongle dadian.
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《东坡志林》所收），含维基文库编者据《永乐大典》补入的署名一句。

basis.en: Northern Song prose; the author died in 1101.
basis.zh: 北宋散文，作者卒于 1101 年。

note.en: Ninety-odd characters written by Su Shi in exile in Huangzhou in 1083, about getting out of bed for the moonlight and walking with a friend. Notice how the courtyard first becomes water and the shadows become water plants, and only then are they named: bamboo and cypress. The last line is a quiet case for idleness as a form of attention.
note.zh: 苏轼 1083 年谪居黄州时写的九十余字：因月色起身，与友人散步。留意庭院先化作积水，影子先化作藻荇，然后才被说破：竹柏影也。最后一句平静地为“闲”辩护：闲，也是一种留心。

excerpt.orig: 庭下如積水空明，水中藻荇交橫，蓋竹柏影也。
excerpt.en: The courtyard was like a pool of clear, empty water, and in the water the stems of water plants crossed one another: the shadows of the bamboo and the cypress.
excerpt.zh: 庭下如积水空明，水中藻荇交横，盖竹柏影也。

gloss.en: 1083, the fourth year of Su Shi’s exile at Huangzhou. Yuanfeng was a reign title of Emperor Shenzong of the Song.
gloss.zh: 公元 1083 年，苏轼贬居黄州的第四年。元丰，宋神宗的年号。

gloss.en: 戶 is a door: the moonlight came in at the door.
念 is to think: there was no one to share the pleasure with.
gloss.zh: 念，想到。没有可以一起游乐的人。

gloss.en: A temple near Huangzhou, today’s Huanggang in Hubei.
gloss.zh: 寺名，在黄州（今湖北黄冈）。

gloss.en: Zhang Mengde, courtesy name Huaimin, also sent to Huangzhou in 1083, who lodged at the temple.
gloss.zh: 张梦得，字怀民，元丰六年也被贬到黄州，寄居承天寺。

gloss.en: Like pooled water, clear and full of light: the moonlight on the ground.
gloss.zh: 像积水一样清澈透明，形容月光。

gloss.en: Water weeds; 荇 is the floating-heart, a small water plant.
gloss.zh: 藻、荇都是水生植物。荇，荇菜。

gloss.en: 蓋 here means ‘it turns out’: these were the shadows of bamboo and cypress.
gloss.zh: 盖，原来是。原来是竹子和柏树的影子。

gloss.en: Idle people: both men held posts with no duties, and both had the leisure to notice the moon.
gloss.zh: 清闲的人。两人都是有职无权的贬官，也都有赏月的闲情。

gloss.en: Deputy Commissioner of the Militia, an empty title given to Su Shi in exile; he was forbidden to sign official papers.
gloss.zh: 苏轼贬黄州时的官衔，是有名无实的闲职，且“不得签书公事”。

gloss.en: Su So-and-so: a modest way for the author to sign his own name.
gloss.zh: 作者自称，谦称自己的名字。
